name: Houman * Smile!
source:
The ever-smiling heartpounding stars of Smile are here to make your lower half Ultra Happy too!

Hello! We're Sunday morning anime transforming magical girls.
Since you've been such a great friend supporting our adventures,
today we 5 are gonna be your little sisters!
Do you like that, oniichan? Hmm? I promise to try hard!

Ready, transformation, GO... chinko rinrin chokyu shaburu! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE116698.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
永远微笑的令人心跳的微笑明星也在这里让你的下半身超快乐！

你好！我们是周日早上的动漫变身魔法少女。
既然你是支持我们冒险的好朋友，
今天我们五个人将成为你们的小姐妹！
你喜欢这样吗，欧尼酱？唔？我保证一定会努力的！

准备好，变身，GO…chinko rinrin chokyu shaburu！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE116698.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
